summary: Auto-merge workflow reads `.plate` autonomy on the default branch, enforces documented eligibility (protected paths, need labels, risk tolerance, label sender), and removes the committed legacy AUTONOMOUS_MODE marker from plate and template payload.
migration_impact: Repositories with only `.github/AUTONOMOUS_MODE` and no `.plate` `autonomy` section keep low-tolerance legacy behavior with a workflow warning. When `.plate` includes `autonomy`, configure `enabled: true` and the desired `risk_tolerance`, then delete `.github/AUTONOMOUS_MODE`. Re-import or sync `auto-merge.yml` from plate_core template payload.
agent_notes: Do not recreate `.github/AUTONOMOUS_MODE` during transition unless the repo truly has no `.plate` autonomy section yet. auto-merge remains opt-in via label + branch protection.
